arxiv-2005-11343.title: Mathematical analysis and potential therapeutic implications of a novel HIV-1 model of basal and activated transcription in T-cells and macrophages
arxiv-2005-11343.creator: Tin Phan 1, Catherine DeMarino 2, Fatah Kashanchi 2, Yang Kuang 1, Daniel M. Anderson 3, Maria Emelianenko 3
arxiv-2005-11343.description: Abstract HIV-1 affects tens of millions of people worldwide. Current treatments often involve a cocktail of antiretroviral drugs, which are effective in reducing the virus and extending life spans. However, there is currently no FDA-approved HIV-1 transcription inhibitor. Furthermore, there have only been a few attempts to model the transcription process in HIV-1.

arxiv-2311-06017.title: Extended formulations for the integer hull of strictly Δ \Delta -modular cographic polyhedral cones
arxiv-2311-06017.creator: Joseph Paat, Zach Walsh, Luze Xu
arxiv-2311-06017.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Joseph Paat, Zach Walsh, Luze Xu. give a compact extended formulation for a class of bimodular-constrained integer programs, namely those that model the stable set polytope of a graph with no disjoint odd cycles. We extend their techniques to design compact extended formulations for the integer hull of translated polyhedral cones whose constraint matrix is strictly Δ \Delta -modular and has rows that represent a cographic matroid. Our work generalizes the important special case from Conforti et al.

arxiv-2410-19176.title: Perturbation-based Graph Active Learning for Weakly-Supervised Belief Representation Learning
arxiv-2410-19176.creator: Dachun Sun, Ruijie Wang, Jinning Li, Ruipeng Han, Xinyi Liu, You Lyu, and Tarek Abdelzaher
arxiv-2410-19176.description: Abstract This paper addresses the problem of optimizing the allocation of labeling resources for semi-supervised belief representation learning in social networks. The objective is to strategically identify valuable messages on social media graphs that are worth labeling within a constrained budget, ultimately maximizing the task’s performance.

arxiv-2412-03432.title: Self-interactions of ultralight spinless dark matter to the rescue?
arxiv-2412-03432.creator: Gaurav Goswami 1
arxiv-2412-03432.description: Abstract Numerous observations on astrophysical and cosmological scales can be interpreted to mean that, in addition to the familiar kind of matter well described by the standard model of elementary particle physics, there exists Dark Matter (DM). The fundamental properties of the elementary particles which make up the DM e.g. particle mass, spin, couplings etc are currently being observationally constrained.

arxiv-2508-02866.title: PROV-AGENT: Unified Provenance for Tracking AI Agent Interactions in Agentic Workflows Thanks: Cite this paper as: R. Souza, A. Gueroudji, S. DeWitt, D. Rosendo, T. Ghosal, R. Ross, P. Balaprakash, R. F. da Silva, “PROV-AGENT: Unified Provenance for Tracking AI Agent Interactions in Agentic Workflow
arxiv-2508-02866.creator: Renan Souza 1 , Amal Gueroudji 2 , Stephen DeWitt 3 , Daniel Rosendo 1 , Tirthankar Ghosal 1 , Robert Ross 2 , Prasanna Balaprakash 4 , Rafael Ferreira da Silva 1
arxiv-2508-02866.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) and other foundation models are increasingly used as the core of AI agents. In agentic workflows , these agents plan tasks, interact with humans and peers, and influence scientific outcomes across federated and heterogeneous environments. However, agents can hallucinate or reason incorrectly, propagating errors when one agent’s output becomes another’s input.

arxiv-2508-12504.title: Organization Matters: A Qualitative Study of Organizational Dynamics in Red Teaming Practices for Generative AI Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 9 7 CSCW460 11 DOI: 10.1145/3757641 CCS: Human-centered computing Collaborative and social computing
arxiv-2508-12504.creator: Bixuan Ren, EunJeong Cheon, Jianghui Li
arxiv-2508-12504.description: Abstract . The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) across diverse fields underscores the critical need for red teaming efforts to proactively identify and mitigate associated risks. While previous research primarily addresses technical aspects, this paper highlights organizational factors that hinder the effectiveness of red teaming in real-world settings.

arxiv-2508-20967.title: Active-set Newton-MR methods for nonconvex optimization problems with bound constraints Thanks: This work has been partially supported by the Brazilian agencies FAPESP (grants 2013/07375-0, 2022/05803-3, 2023/08706-1, and 2024/22384-0) and CNPq (grant 302073/2022-1).
arxiv-2508-20967.creator: Ernesto G. Birgin, Geovani N. Grapiglia, Diaulas S. Marcondes
arxiv-2508-20967.description: Abstract This paper presents active-set methods for minimizing nonconvex twice-continuously differentiable functions subject to bound constraints. Within the faces of the feasible set, we employ descent methods with Armijo line search, utilizing approximated Newton directions obtained through the Minimum Residual (MINRES) method.

pmc-10715970.title: Multidisciplinary Approach to Management of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy With Severe Left Ventricular Outflow Obstruction in Pregnancy
pmc-10715970.creator: Aditya Bhave, Gem Mohan, Lindsey Couture, Gyanendra Sharma, Juliet Yirerong
pmc-10715970.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Pregnancy can worsen symptoms of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and increase the risk of complications. Severe left ventricular outflow tract obstruction with gradient >100 mm Hg poses a high risk of deterioration during pregnancy. We present a patient with hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy in the third trimester of pregnancy with a left ventricular outflow tract gradient >100 mm Hg and discuss successful interdisciplinary management.

pmc-11503927.title: Molecular Screening and Characterization of Enteric Protozoan Parasites and Microsporidia in Wild Ducks from Portugal
pmc-11503927.creator: Sara Gomes-Gonçalves, David Rodrigues, Nuno Santos, Nausicaa Gantois, Magali Chabé, Eric Viscogliosi, João R Mesquita, Francesca Mancianti
pmc-11503927.description: Simple SummaryEnteric parasites, including Blastocystis sp., Balantioides coli, Cryptosporidium spp. and microsporidia, are major public health concerns. This study explores the prevalence of these parasites in wild ducks (Anas acuta, Anas platyrhynchos and Anas crecca) in Portugal. It provides the first molecular evidence of Blastocystis sp. ST7 and Cryptosporidium baileyi in these birds.

pmc-11572686.title: Translation, Cultural Adaptation, and Psychometric Properties of Hindi Rosenberg Self-esteem Scale in University Nursing Students
pmc-11572686.creator: Aachal, Rajesh Kumar, Yogesh Bahurupi
pmc-11572686.description: Background:Rosenberg’s Self-esteem Scale (RSES) has been widely used without proper translation, cultural adaptation, and testing psychometric properties in Indian studies. The study aimed to translate and culturally adapt the 10-item Rosenberg Self-esteem Scale into Hindi and find psychometric properties.Material and Methods:We have translated the scale using World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines.

pmc-12405608.title: A mechanical route for cooperative transport in autonomous robotic swarms
pmc-12405608.creator: Eden Arbel, Luco Buise, Charlotte van Waes, Naomi Oppenheimer, Yoav Lahini, Matan Yah Ben Zion
pmc-12405608.description: Cooperative transport is a striking phenomenon where multiple agents join forces to transit a payload too heavy for the individual. While social animals such as ants are routinely observed to coordinate transport at scale, reproducing the effect in artificial swarms remains challenging, as it requires synchronization in a noisy many-body system.

pmc-13015572.title: Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy Among Peripartum Cardiomyopathy Heart Transplant Recipients in the United States

pmc-13015572.description: Graphical AbstractKey words: cardiac allograft vasculopathy, heart transplantation, peripartum cardiomyopathy What is the clinical question being addressed? What are the incidence and predictors of cardiac allograft vasculopathy PPCM heart transplant recipients in the contemporary era? What is the main finding? PPCM heart transplants have more than doubled annually from 27 in 2010 to 58 in 2022.

pmc-13070418.title: Mapping Biomedical Engineering Education and Research in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Bibliometric and Systematic Analysis
pmc-13070418.creator: Joseph O Dirisu, Thywill Cephas Dzogbewu, Deon Johan De Beer
pmc-13070418.description: Biomedical engineering (BME) education is critical to the growth of engineering-driven healthcare entrepreneurs and the enhancement of health systems globally. This study examines the evolution of BME education research over the past 20 years, with a focus on Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), using a mixed-methods approach that includes bibliometric analysis and a systematic literature review.

pmc-13100902.creator: Uzezi E Okinedo, Brook T Moyers, David Alvarez-Ponce
pmc-13100902.description: Local adaptation drives changes in population phenotypes that confer survival or reproductive success in specific environments. Local adaptation may be hindered or facilitated by pleiotropy, which is the control of multiple traits by a single genetic locus. pmc-13253828.title: Observation of D’yakonov-Perel’-type magnon spin relaxation in uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulators
pmc-13253828.creator: Qinwu Gao, Andi Cong, Bokai Liang, Meng Yang, Jingjing Liu, Lang Chen, Shiwei Wu, Ka Shen, Junxue Li
pmc-13253828.description: Long-distance transport of magnon spin currents in antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulators has attracted tremendous attention recently, however, the AFM magnon spin relaxation mechanisms remain elusive. Here, we report that the D’yakonov-Perel’-type magnon spin relaxation mechanism governs the spin current transport along the easy axis in two prototypical uniaxial AFM insulators, Cr2O3 and α-Fe2O3.

pmc-13542988.title: Fatty Acid‐Binding Protein 5 Potentially Regulates the Proliferation and Metastasis of Uveal Melanoma Cells Through the PI3K/AKT/mTOR Signaling Pathway

pmc-13542988.description: BackgroundUveal melanoma (UVM) is an aggressive intraocular tumor with limited effective treatments for metastatic disease.
